judge.note: The judge ran through the Claude Code command-line client at high reasoning effort.

sample.rule: Within each direction and text type, the item ids sorted by SHA-256 of 'translate-bench/v1/judge-sample/' followed by the id; the first 8.

aggregation: Each direction counts equally and its sentences and passages 50:50 (item weight 1 / (D * 2 * n) in a cell of n items, D directions); 'all' uses the directions with both text types. Pairwise: net is the weighted mean of +1 (preferred to the reference), -1 (reference preferred) and 0 (tie, judged or identical); preferred is the weighted share of the decided items. Errors: error_free is the weighted share of items with no error counted; penalty is 25 per critical, 5 per major and 1 per minor error. Wins, losses, ties and identical are raw counts.

bootstrap.description: 95% percentile intervals of paired document draws: the sampled source documents are drawn with replacement within strata of documents that cover the same cells of the release's inputs; a document's draw count applies to all its items; a draw that leaves a needed cell without documents is skipped (draws counts the draws used).
